```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

clean = pd.read_csv("../data/processed/retail_sales_index_clean.csv", parse_dates=["period"])
summary = pd.read_csv("../outputs/tables/headline_summary.csv").iloc[0]

latest_period = str(summary["latest_period"])
latest_value = f"{float(summary['latest_value']):.1f}"
previous_period = str(summary["previous_period"])
direction = str(summary["direction"])
month_on_month_change = f"{float(summary['month_on_month_change']):.1f}"
year_on_year_change = f"{float(summary['year_on_year_change']):.1f}"
dataset_title = str(summary["dataset_title"])
dataset_version = str(int(summary["dataset_version"]))
release_date = str(summary["release_date"])
retrieved_at_utc = str(summary["retrieved_at_utc"])
source_url = str(summary["source_url"])
```
